```sql
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS home_win_rate
FROM main."Match"
WHERE league_id = (SELECT id FROM main."League" WHERE country_id = (SELECT id FROM main."Country" WHERE name = 'England') AND name = 'England Premier League')
  AND season = '2015/2016'
  AND date >= '2015-08-01'
  AND date <= '2016-05-25'
```
